headline: Zabit Returns
caption:
Zabit Magomedsharipov is back, signing a multi-fight deal with RAF wrestling.
Zabit or Giga? 👇

The former UFC featherweight star, who went 6-0 in the UFC, debuts against UFC veteran Giga Chikadze at RAF Abu Dhabi on Nov. 14, per MMA Junkie. Khamzat Chimaev vs. Colby Covington reportedly tops the card. Wrestling news.

Who takes it?
question: Zabit or Giga?
